steps.name: Baseline
steps.summary: Record monorepo engine-test count and pass/fail from `dotnet test` on Cymulate.Integration.Yaml.Engine.Test. This number is the gate for every later step.

steps.name: Move engine verbatim
steps.summary: Copy 65 engine files to src/Cymulate.Integration.Yaml.Engine/ with folder structure unchanged. Rewrite csproj for CPM (no Version attributes) and keep the EmbeddedResource LogicalName exactly.

steps.name: Move test project verbatim
steps.summary: Copy 73 test files to tests/Cymulate.Integration.Yaml.Engine.Test/, repoint ProjectReference at the new engine path.

steps.name: Wire slnx and prove parity
steps.summary: Add both projects to Cymulate.Integration.Yaml.Engine.slnx. `dotnet test` must report the S0 baseline count, all passing.

steps.name: Commit phase 1
steps.summary: Single commit, content unchanged, so review sees an isolated move.

steps.name: Create concept folders and split types
steps.summary: Build the nine Concept/Contracts/Logic trees from ARCHITECTURE.md. Split every multi-type file to one top-level type per file. Dissolve Models/.

steps.name: Update namespaces
steps.summary: Namespace tracks the concept, not the folder. Update engine files, then test-project usings.

steps.name: Rename test project to .Tests
steps.summary: Align with README.md and convention; mirror concept folders in the test tree without the Contracts/Logic split.

steps.name: Prove zero behavioural diff
steps.summary: `dotnet test` reports the S0 baseline count, all passing. No method body changed anywhere in the diff.

steps.name: Commit phase 2
steps.summary: Second commit on the same branch.

notes: All 113 engine type bodies byte-identical to phase 1 - no method body changed
Nine namespaces, one per concept; no .Contracts/.Logic segments; Models/ removed
Schema LogicalName intact; zero Cymulate.* package references; monorepo untouched

openDecisions: runtime defects 1-3 (spill cleanup, ConcurrentDictionary, Hmac naming+tests) - phase 3 or fix branch
